# Principle 2.5

> At design time, add a layer, interface or abstraction only when you can name the concrete benefit it brings today

- Category: Design and architecture (2)
- Status: active
- Sources: [rstack](https://github.com/michaelshimeles/rstack), [Karpathy](https://github.com/multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills), [ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)
